Cell type proportion analysis

Source: R/proportions.R
runProportionsPipeline.Rd

Computes per-image proportions of every cell type using original labels (unweighted) and bootstrap confidences (weighted), and tests each against an outcome with a linear model. runProportionsRelativeToParentPipeline() instead expresses each subtype as a proportion of its parent group.

Usage

runProportionsPipeline(
  spe,
  cellTypeTree,
  confList,
  outcomeCol,
  skipGroups = character(0),
  subject = NULL,
  cellType = "cellType",
  cellID = "cellID",
  imageID = "imageID"
)

runProportionsRelativeToParentPipeline(
  spe,
  cellTypeTree,
  confList,
  outcomeCol,
  skipGroups = character(0),
  subject = NULL,
  cellType = "cellType",
  cellID = "cellID",
  imageID = "imageID"
)

Arguments

spe

A SummarizedExperiment (e.g. SpatialExperiment) with a cell ID, cell type and image for every cell in colData.

cellTypeTree

A cell type tree, see cellTypeTree.

confList

Confidence list from bootstrapLineageConfidence(): a named list with one data frame per group, whose names must be groups of cellTypeTree.

outcomeCol

Name of the per-image outcome column in colData(spe). It must have exactly two levels (subset your data to two conditions first) and a single value per image: repeated measures and mixed models are not supported. An error is raised otherwise, before any computation.

skipGroups

Names of groups of cellTypeTree to exclude, as a character vector (the default character(0) excludes none). An error is raised for a name that is not a group of the tree, so the same skipGroups can be used here and in bootstrapLineageConfidence().

subject

Name of the colData(spe) column identifying the subject (for example the patient) each image comes from, or NULL. If given, every image must belong to one subject and every subject must contribute only one image, as in runColocalisationModels(). With NULL this cannot be checked, and a message says so.

cellType, cellID, imageID

Names of the colData(spe) columns holding each cell's cell type label, a unique cell ID (matching the cellID column of confList), and the image it is in.

Value

A list with proportions, weighted, unweighted (long data.frames; only proportions and not weighted/unweighted for the relative-to-parent version), and modelWeighted and modelUnweighted (per cell type model results, where estimate is the difference for the second level of the outcome compared with the first).

Details

In runProportionsPipeline() the unweighted results cover every cell type and also the whole groups that were bootstrapped. Only the subtypes of those groups have confidences, so for every other cell type (cell types without a group, and the group-level proportions) the weighted proportion is the unweighted one: their labels are not uncertain. The weighted and unweighted models therefore test the same set of cell types, and their adjusted p-values are comparable.

The lineage column of the results is the group a subtype belongs to (not the broad lineage). For cell types without a group and for the group-level proportions it is the cell type or group itself.

Examples

data(lungSubset)
data(lungCellTypeTree)
data(lungConfList)
res = runProportionsPipeline(lungSubset, lungCellTypeTree, lungConfList,
    outcomeCol = "disease_status", subject = "subject")
#> Computing unweighted proportions once (shared across all subtypes)...
#> Computing weighted proportions...
#> Fitting weighted models...
head(res$modelWeighted)
#>                      cellType      estimate   statistic      p.value
#> 1           SPP1+ Macrophages -1.310508e-02 -0.77121245 0.4627488770
#> 2    Interstitial Macrophages  3.940842e-02  1.21029437 0.2607089576
#> 3              Monocytes/MDMs -4.222446e-02 -3.99016928 0.0040043674
#> 4 Macrophages - IFN-activated -4.393489e-05 -0.01618578 0.9874825679
#> 5        Alveolar Macrophages -1.883044e-02 -2.55869696 0.0337152591
#> 6                        pDCs  2.360524e-03  5.18432305 0.0008383089
#>         p.adj            lineage
#> 1 0.548469011 Macrophage lineage
#> 2 0.360990284 Macrophage lineage
#> 3 0.021529968 Macrophage lineage
#> 4 0.987482568 Macrophage lineage
#> 5 0.075093077 Macrophage lineage
#> 6 0.008215428    Dendritic cells
data(lungSubset)
data(lungCellTypeTree)
data(lungConfList)
rel = runProportionsRelativeToParentPipeline(lungSubset, lungCellTypeTree,
    lungConfList, outcomeCol = "disease_status", subject = "subject")
#> Computing proportions relative to parent...
#> Fitting unweighted models...
#> Fitting weighted models...
head(rel$modelWeighted)
#>                      cellType     estimate  statistic     p.value       p.adj
#> 1           SPP1+ Macrophages -0.029486426 -0.5204482 0.616844007 0.691612978
#> 2    Interstitial Macrophages  0.385256132  5.0620114 0.000974614 0.006990969
#> 3              Monocytes/MDMs -0.241737210 -3.5653447 0.007343301 0.029427683
#> 4 Macrophages - IFN-activated  0.007970252  0.7049458 0.500849179 0.617713988
#> 5        Alveolar Macrophages -0.122002748 -2.5142228 0.036132460 0.102838540
#> 6                        pDCs  0.160183081  1.3522973 0.213262143 0.343073882
#>              lineage
#> 1 Macrophage lineage
#> 2 Macrophage lineage
#> 3 Macrophage lineage
#> 4 Macrophage lineage
#> 5 Macrophage lineage
#> 6    Dendritic cells
